notes:
Account snapshot: LitMesh builds compliance search for large law firms and internal legal ops. They ingest client contracts, court filings, regulatory records. Primary ask: high-recall RAG with deterministic audit trails and per-tenant retention policies.

Discovery/requirements (from 2026-02 calls):
- Index scale: pilot 5M documents (~1.2TB raw), prod target 40-60M docs across 3 legal practice groups. Expect frequent updates (delta pushes nightly, some near-real-time ingestion for filings).
- Embeddings: want 1536-d embeddings (open model OK) but open to Redwood-verified vector models if quality/cost better. Concerned about embedding compute window on full reindex.
- Reranking: central to UX. Prefer lightweight cross-encoder reranker for top-50 candidates, latency SLO 150-250ms p95 for rerank step.
- Latency/throughput: search latency end-to-end target <= 300ms p95 for single query (embeddings + retrieval + rerank) for interactive UI; batch / bulk review throughput 300 qps required for batch re-eval.
- Cost per query target: <$0.02/query (avg) for standard retrieval; OK to trade slightly higher for high-value legal review flows.
- Routing/fallback: need model routing by sensitivity tier. Cold storage fallback for older docs; prefer transparent fallback to cheaper embedding variant under heavy load.

Security & compliance:
- Deployment: VPC/private control plane required (customer-managed network). Evaluating Redwood Private or Dedicated in VPC.
- Data residency: US-only; legal holds require preserved copies for 7 years with immutable retention flags.
- Audit logging: full token-level and request-level logs retained 2 years, exportable to customer SIEM (Splunk). Must present tamper-evident audit trail for eDiscovery.
- Identity & keys: SSO (SAML 2.0), envelope encryption using customer KMS/HSM, key rotation policy required.
- Certifications: SOC2 required; ISO27001 preferred.

POC scope & success criteria:
- 2-week proof: index 1M docs, demonstrate search latency <=300ms p95, reranker p95 <=200ms using Redwood runtime in VPC. Provide cost projection for 40M index.
- Evaluation metrics: recall @100 > 0.92 on 3 internal test sets, rerank MRR improvement > 18% vs BM25 baseline, audit log ingestion into Splunk validated.
- Deliverables: POC runbook, infra diagram, ingestion scripts, security config template, cost model.
